An '''ossyth''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] that could be found in the deep areas of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]],<ref name="GCG" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Some [[Gender/Legends|female]] members of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet,<ref name="UAA" /> had "Ossyth" as their first name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ossyth gemstones were first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]. They were only described in a table of Quarren female names.<ref name="GCG" />
